title: SDLC Task Test Strategy v1
description: The task-specific payload for defining the minimum evidence-oriented test strategy for an implementation. Intent records the implementation inputs, requirements, objectives, and design-derived invariants under test. Result records required and recommended test cases, fixtures, procedures, expected outcomes, coverage mappings, and evidence limitations without claiming that any test passed.
$comment: The common https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/task-envelope/v1 owns task identity, processing state, dependencies, task routing, repository context, and the common task wrapper. This payload has exactly two high-level properties: intent and result. The strategy is a prerequisite only when the applicable task policy materializes it; when materialized, an implementation task should declare an explicit dependsOn reference to the completed strategy task. Host validation must resolve all references, enforce unique IDs, verify complete requirement/invariant/objective coverage, ensure minimumRequiredTestCaseRefs identify required test cases, ensure recommendedTestCaseRefs identify recommended test cases, and never treat this strategy result as execution evidence. A later implementation result records actual evidence and references these test-case IDs. Evidence-tier values use the canonical https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/evidence/v1 vocabulary.
